feedback: The confession follows the available chain closely: the professor admits reading the exact condition his query quoted, identifies the preview and private glass as his opportunities, and connects the threat to his scholarly reputation. Taking poison during the preview supplies the confessed action rather than a new evidentiary fact needed to select him. His closing statements to Dada and Reed turn professional vanity into personal regret, which feels earned by the earlier audience anxiety and student tension. Hugh and Chip’s admissions keep their culpability meaningful despite innocence of murder. The finale is satisfying and concise, although its explicit restatement of the deduction reinforces the unusually conspicuous final denial.
